parsed.post: Reverting the high learning rate experiment which caused regression (0.865 vs 0.834). Returning to my best commit (692c13d). My next move is to increase the TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to improve gradient stability and sample efficiency, while keeping the stabilized MATRIX_LR.
parsed.description: Increasing TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 1048576 to improve gradient stability and potentially reach better minima, while maintaining the successful MATRIX_LR and WARMUP_RATIO from commit 692c13d.
